# Moritex MML04-HR120D (object-side telecentric, 0.4x, WD 120, coaxial port)

Owner-selected for v13 (replaces MML05-HR110D): 10 mm more working distance lets the camera sit 15 mm higher at D 65 from the spindle.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Magnification | 0.40 |
| WD / OD | 120.0 ± 3.6 / 123.2 mm |
| DOF | 5.3 mm (PCoC 0.04) |
| Resolution | 17.7 µm @ 550 nm |
| Effective Fno / NA | 10.6 / 0.019 |
| Tube length | 174.1 mm (+ C thread 4) |
| Outline | Ø45 front 85 long, taper to Ø22, coaxial port Ø8 (M3 lock) 116.5 behind the front, Ø29 ring at the C-mount |
| Image circle | Ø11 (2/3" max) |
| Weight | 232 g |

STEP frame (`MML04-HR120D.step`): axis +Z, front face z +123.07, C-mount flange z −51.03 (thread to −55.02), light port toward +Y at z 6.57.

Files: `MML04-HR120D.step` (vendor, from the RAR on moritex.com), `MML04-HR120D_HR120.pdf` (datasheet), `drawing_mml04-hr120d_a001.PDF`.
Source: https://www.moritex.com/Lens/215_9580.html
